title: Poll wins, constant travel and quitting at the Plaza Nine
summary: Sam wins awards but tires of airports, sees a three-week Plaza Nine booking, and decides to leave the trio.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: So uhm, uhm, sure enough he had never won the poll, man.
As a group, and we won the Playboy poll, uhm, uhm, but the group, I got to thinking man, uhm, I then ~
I won Musician of the Year from Denmark. It's on the, on the back of the Encyclopedia of Jazz -- Did you ever see that?
Uhm, uhm and I just got tired of traveling because there was, we lived in airplanes and airports, man.

And uhm, I was never home man. 5½ years, I was all over the world, Africa, I'm in Japan, Asia, I don't know, everywhere, I don't even ask where I'm going no more you know. Like uh, like this time of year I know where I'm going to be playing at next year this time, that's how far booked, was like booked.
So it was too much work. So finally I saw on the itinerary, on my itinerary where we was going to be playing downtown at a hotel downtown on Fifth Avenue. Remember that club?
I saw that we was going to be in there for three weeks and I said, uh oh, that's where I'm splitting from,
Well, that's right cause I was working in the house trio, remember?
This is where I'm giving it up.
Yeah, I remember that's when you told me then, weren't going to do that.
